biological.citation: Identifying Novel Osteoarthritis-Associated Genes in Human Cartilage Using a Systematic Meta-Analysis and a Multi-Source Integrated Network (PMID: 35457215)
biological.summary: ARPC4-TTLL3 was identified as a novel osteoarthritis-associated protein through systematic meta-analysis of differentially expressed genes in human osteoarthritic cartilage and confirmed by mass spectrometry analysis across different cartilage zones (superficial, middle, and deep) compared to normal controls.
biological.sample_size: 1689 genes analyzed in co-expression network; human osteoarthritic cartilage samples from multiple zones
biological.significance: p < 0.01 for pathway enrichment overlap with cellular senescence drivers
